{{YFHR|116}} ==Events== * [[Tylaric Stormwing]] came to [[Sigil]].{{b|Planescape|The Eternal Boundary|pdf=17300|page=17}} * The town of [[Elshava]]'s Fisher King, [[Calleron]], Lord of the Selkies, dies unmarried and without an heir. He is succeeded by his sister, [[Elothien]] the Silent, over much public protest.{{b|Planescape|Planes of Chaos|pdf=17298|page=52, Book of Chaos}} * [[Alisohn Nilesia]], eight years old, attempts to become a full member of the [[Mercykillers]]. [[Factol]] [[Mallin]] turns her down.{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=102}} * [[Cyric]], a mortal thief, slays one of the embodied gods of [[Toril]], and thus assumes his portfolio.{{b|Planescape|On Hallowed Ground|pdf=121101|page=168}} == Background Information == * Cyric ascending to godhood happens "a dozen or so years ago" (from 128 YFHR), which we have assumed is literal, taking place in 116 YFHR. This event happens during Forgotten Realms' Time of Troubles in the year [[w:c:forgottenrealms:1358 DR|1358 DR]], which gives us a touchstone for comparing timelines between the two settings. ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%" | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''

{{YFHR|117}} ==Events== * The [[First Eschaton]]: A year of bad omens. People have bad dreams and uneasy visions, the [[Lady of Pain]] make an inauspicious 13 appearances in the short timeframe of 23 days, and [[Mercykiller]] [[Factol]] [[Votohm]] dies under mysterious circumstances.{{b|Planescape|Faction War (book)|alt=Faction War|pdf=17299|page=64}} * The [[Xaositects]] manage to arrange an alliance with every other [[faction]] at once. The alliance only lasts about 12 minute once everyone figures out what's going on.{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=152}} * [[Sougad Lawshredder]] goes on a murder spree for a week, leaving Cagers in terror. The [[Believers of the Source]] capture him and take him to [[Harbinger House]], with the hope that his murderous tendencies would fade as he ascended toward godhood.{{b|Planescape|Harbinger House (book)|alt=Harbinger House|pdf=17277|page=10}} * [[Flandal Steelskin]]'s best smith and [[proxy]], [[Gilliana Heatforge]], loses several family members, including her father, when [[Urdlen]] the Crawler Below causes the collapse of her family's tunnels.{{b|Planescape|Planes of Conflict|pdf=17278|page=38, Liber Benevolentiae}} ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%" | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''

{{YFHR|121}} ==Events== * [[Tylaric Stormwing]] takes a wrong turn and ends up in the [[Abyss]]. When he comes back, he's a screaming [[barmy]].{{b|Planescape|The Eternal Boundary|pdf=17300|page=17}} * [[Erin Darkflame Montgomery]], a member of a decadent group called the [[Pax Imperica]], falls for a half-elf named [[Cuatha Da'nanin]]. She frees him from a death in a spectacle of atrocity called the [[Spit]], and the two flee to [[Sigil]].{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=133-134}} * The bard [[Trolan]] of [[Ecstasy]] arrives in [[Sigil]] and finds a tavern to perform in. He performs a song of love to the [[Lady of Pain]]. The crowd flees and he's kicked out, with the expectation that the Lady would quickly arrive to dispatch him, but she never does. He's quickly branded Trolan the Mad. The [[Mercykillers]] were ready to deal with him when the [[dabus]] showed up to take him to [[Harbinger House]].{{b|Planescape|Harbinger House (book)|alt=Harbinger House|pdf=17277|page=11}} * [[The Nameless One]], going by the name "Thlium," is owed 100 copper by a Cager.{{b|Planescape|Planescape: Torment}} ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%" | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''

{{YFHR|123}} ==Events== * [[Eliath]] researched where a portal might lead, possibly the [[Isle of Black Trees]]. He disappeared for more than a year afterward -- the book in the city library drove him insane, and he ended up in the [[Hive]].{{b|Planescape|The Eternal Boundary|pdf=17300|page=7}}{{b|Planescape|The Eternal Boundary|pdf=17300|page=16}} * The wizard [[Rhaunades]] is killed in a magical duel, leaving behind a collection.{{b|Planescape|The Eternal Boundary|pdf=17300|page=17}} * [[Interplanar Importers]] in The [[Lady's Ward]] is turned into a secret [[Revolutionary League]] safe house by the [[Quin|owner]]'s daughter [[Strader]].{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=115}} * [[Kesto Brighteyes]] buys a bookshop in the [[Lower Ward]] called the [[Parted Veil]]. He sets two dozen round panes of crystal into the outer wall so passers-by can see into the store.{{b|Planescape|Uncaged: Faces of Sigil|pdf=17285|page=16}} ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%" | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''

{{YFHR|124}} ==Events== * [[Kiim Madbone]] is framed by the [[Revolutionary League]] for the death of two [[Mercykiller]] [[factor]]s.{{b|Planescape|Faction War (book)|alt=Faction War|pdf=17299|page=90}} * Half-orc [[Lhar]] becomes [[factol]] of the [[Bleak Cabal]].{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=26}}{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=28}} * The [[bariaur]] [[Zebrinth]] moves into [[Crux]].{{b|Planescape|Dead Gods|pdf=17297|page=30}} * [[The Nameless One]] breaks into [[Iannis]]' office and burns his legal documentation.{{b|Planescape|Planescape: Torment}} ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%" | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''

{{YFHR|125}} ==Events== * Duke [[Rowan Darkwood]] enters [[Sigil]], and very shortly becomes one of the two most-powerful people in the city, the [[Factol]] of the [[Fated]]. He takes over from Factol [[Emma Oakwright]].{{b|Planescape|Planescape Campaign Setting|pdf=17267|page=73, Sigil and Beyond}}{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=58}}{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=60}} * A half-elf going by "The [[Shadowknave]]" arrives in Sigil.{{b|Planescape|The Eternal Boundary|pdf=17300|page=6}} * [[Hagus Gimcrack]] is banished to [[Pandemonium]], finds his way to [[Windglum]], applies for citizenship, and purchases the [[Scaly Dog Inn]] with jewelry he had on his person.{{b|Planescape|Planes of Chaos|pdf=17298|page=36, Travelogue}} * The [[Xaositects]] collectively act "normal" for about a week. It weirded out Cagers who wondered what they were up to. Turns out nothing, it just worked out that way.{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=156}} * [[Caili Jaspar]] joins [[Corpus]] as the Mouth of the town.{{b|Planescape|Planes of Conflict|pdf=17278|page=60, Liber Malevolentiae}} * [[Sigil|Cager]]s create a press sheet with daily reports about the [[Blood War]], called ''[[Life in Wartime]]''.{{b|Planescape|Hellbound: The Blood War|pdf=17281|page=29, The Chant of the War}} * The [[githyanki]] settle in the [[Astral Plane]].{{b|Planescape|A Guide to the Astral Plane|pdf=17287|page=4}} * An earthquake shakes the [[Lady's Ward]], as [[Nontegue Manor]]'s efforts to extend their underground crypts break into an area of [[UnderSigil]].{{b|Planescape|Faction War (book)|alt=Faction War|pdf=17299|page=84}} * The events of ''[[Planescape: Torment]]''. The [[Nameless One]]'s final incarnation awakens in the [[Mortuary]], gathers companions to his cause, and finally defeats the [[Transcendent One]] who has been chasing him for thousands of years.{{b|Planescape|Planescape: Torment}}: [[Prophyra]], a woman in the Marketplace area of the [[Hive Ward]], predicts a great faction war in five years' time. ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%" | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''

{{YFHR|131}} ==Events== * One year post-[[Faction War]]. == Background Information == * Dating information post-[[Faction War]] is nonexistent, but if we assume that time continues to pass at the same rate of one in-universe year per real-world production year, the following titles take place in this year: ** {{b|D&D|TSR Jam 1999|pdf=17297}}, "The Manxome Foe" ** {{b|D&D|Warriors of Heaven|pdf=17387}} ** {{b|D&D|Guide to Hell|pdf=17390}} ** {{b|Polyhedron|Polyhedron Magazine 137}}, "Of Sigil and the Sea" * Given that Factol Hashkar died during the [[Faction War]] and the [[Fraternity of Order]] retreated to [[Mechanus]], they may have elected a new factol. In which case, this year would be recorded as year 1 of the new factol's reign, rather than year 131 of Factol Hashkar's reign. ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%; text-align:center;" |- | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''
